subject.title: fix(agents): terminate agent run on critical loop detection instead of continuing indefinitely

question: After real-runtime proof is supplied, should this PR or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106423 become the canonical fix for critical tool-loop termination?
rationale: Both branches target the same canonical issue with substantially the same agent-core contract, and selecting between them requires owner judgment about the permanent hook surface, test shape, and transcript semantics.

options.title: Select this PR after proof
options.body: Use this branch if a live run confirms normal terminal state, correct persisted transcript, completed sibling tools, and no subsequent provider turn.

options.title: Select the competing PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106423 if its smaller implementation or proof provides a clearer permanent owner boundary.

options.title: Replace both implementations
options.body: Pause both candidates only if the runtime owner identifies a narrower existing contract that handles single and mixed batches without adding this hook.

recommendation.title: Select this PR after proof
recommendation.body: Use this branch if a live run confirms normal terminal state, correct persisted transcript, completed sibling tools, and no subsequent provider turn.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent agent-runtime merge history makes this person the strongest available owner for choosing the permanent loop and terminal-state contract.
